# Fixture Repositories

Fixture repositories for deterministic ContextLock tests will live here.

Required early fixtures:

- `empty-git-repo/`
- `node-basic/`
- `python-basic/`
- `node-with-node-modules/`
- `todo-markers/`
- `dirty-working-tree/`
